trace.final_message:
I added `hourglass/rounding.py` and `tests/test_rounding.py`, and committed them as `e289985`. `make check` passes with all 33 tests (the 26 existing ones plus 7 new), and `tools/lint.py` found no syntax errors.

`span_labels(spans, step)` rounds each start and end to the nearest multiple of `step` and returns labels like `09:00-17:15 (8h 15m)`, in the same order as the input.
- **Halves:** these round up. With a 30-minute step, 09:15 becomes 09:30.
- **Bad steps:** a step that is zero, negative, not a whole number, or doesn't divide 60 evenly raises `ValueError`. That covers 0, -15, 7, 45, 120 and 2.5, which the tests check.
- **Collapsing spans:** a span that rounds down to zero length, such as 10:01-10:03 with a 15-minute step, raises `ValueError` from `Span`. I left that as is instead of returning an empty label. Say so if payroll wants those handled differently.

I also added a line for the new function to `docs/api.txt` and an entry under "Unreleased" in `CHANGES.txt`. I didn't export it from `hourglass/__init__.py`.

The code follows the `CLAUDE.md` conventions. Along the way I fixed two lines that were over 60 characters and some double blank lines. I ran `git diff --cached --stat` before committing, but I didn't read the full diff line by line.

`tests/test_rounding.py` changed on disk after I committed. Line 6 now has a single blank line before `class RoundingTests`, and line 38 has one before `if __name__`. The commit may not include that version, so check `git status`.

## Unreleased

- worker_minutes no longer merges overlaps for the same worker.

before.docs/api.txt:
hourglass.parsing.parse_clock(text): read a clock time as minutes since midnight
hourglass.parsing.format_clock(minutes): minutes since midnight as HH:MM
hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text): read a range such as 09:00-17:30
hourglass.parsing.format_span(span): a span as start-end text
hourglass.parsing.normalize_day(text): short lowercase day name
hourglass.merging.spans_overlap(first, second): whether two spans share any time
hourglass.merging.intersect_spans(first, second): the part two spans share
hourglass.merging.merge_spans(spans): collapse overlaps into a sorted list
hourglass.merging.total_minutes(spans): minutes covered, overlaps counted once
hourglass.schedule.parse_schedule_text(text): parse schedule CSV held in memory
hourglass.schedule.load_schedule(path): read a schedule CSV from disk
hourglass.schedule.shifts_for_worker(shifts, worker): all shifts for one worker
hourglass.schedule.worker_minutes(shifts): scheduled minutes per worker
hourglass.schedule.day_coverage(shifts, day): merged spans for a day
hourglass.schedule.format_day_line(shifts, day): one text line for a day
